description: Multi-intent requests: first router plus expected route plan (chain); companion noted but not scored yet

prompts.prompt: The checkout page throws a 500 in production. Find the cause, fix it, and get it live.
prompts.boundary: prod bugfix: unknown root cause starts at debug, never ship first

prompts.prompt: Our product page is painfully slow. Find out why, fix it, and deploy the fix.
prompts.boundary: perf fix chain: measured slowness starts at perf, not debug

prompts.prompt: Plan and build a settings page with profile, billing and notification tabs.
prompts.boundary: new multi-screen feature: plan first, then build UI

prompts.prompt: CI is failing on the cart tests and I don't know why. Work out the cause and then push the fix.
prompts.boundary: unknown root cause then commit: debug before ship

prompts.prompt: Commit this change, then make a launch video about it.
prompts.boundary: ship then brag video; video is the second step, not the first

prompts.prompt: Deploy the preview to Vercel and then check the signup flow in a real browser.
prompts.boundary: deploy-verify: qa starts only once the deployment is live

prompts.prompt: Build a support chatbot with streaming responses and a polished chat UI.
prompts.boundary: AI SDK wiring first, UI second

prompts.prompt: Add a Supabase migration for the orders table with row level security, then ship it.
prompts.boundary: migration then commit; RLS adds a security checklist

prompts.prompt: Build the Expo onboarding screens, write the App Store listing, and submit the build with EAS.
prompts.boundary: expo store launch: build, listing copy, then release

prompts.prompt: Review this PR and then fix whatever you find.
prompts.boundary: review findings are fixed by ship, not by review

prompts.prompt: Audit our auth code for vulnerabilities, fix what you find, and release it.
prompts.boundary: security findings handed to ship, then deploy

prompts.prompt: Build a launch landing page with a hero demo video, and keep LCP under 2.5 seconds.
prompts.boundary: page first, video asset second; a stated LCP budget calls the perf companion

prompts.prompt: The hero animation drops frames on scroll. Work out what is causing it and then smooth it out.
prompts.boundary: janky animation: diagnose (perf) then author the fix (motion)

prompts.prompt: Write tests for the invoice module and then smoke test it in the browser.
prompts.boundary: test files first, browser smoke test second

prompts.prompt: Fix the typo in the pricing header, commit it, and push it live.
prompts.boundary: small scoped fix then go live

prompts.prompt: Fix the Stripe webhook signature check and ship it.
prompts.boundary: single router; payments in the diff call the security companion

prompts.prompt: Wire up a RAG support chatbot with the AI SDK and score its answer quality against a test set.
prompts.boundary: AI SDK wiring is ai; the scoring harness is borrowed from the agents companion

prompts.prompt: How does the auth middleware work?
prompts.boundary: control: single intent, no chain

prompts.prompt: The dropdown shows the wrong data when I select an item.
prompts.boundary: control: single intent, no chain

prompts.prompt: Write a PRD for the new analytics dashboard.
prompts.boundary: control: single intent, no chain
